name: Origin coordinator → routed autoresearch failed reply
description: The actual origin loop publishes the reply coordinator using native parent inheritance. run_scope=new idempotently asserts the existing origin-rooted run, preserving its phase and verifying its stored origin; it selects this root even if the loop retains an older inherited run anchor. The frozen executor can publish parent-only after a Mint error; this rule does not claim transactional fail-closed publication.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.coordinator
on_enter.prompt: The autoresearch run failed. Read the failed source using read_loop_result(loop_id="$entity.triple.autoresearch.reply.failed"). Report the observed failure and partial evidence plainly. A missing or incomplete result is not success. Finish with decide(action="respond_direct", reason="<honest failure summary>"). Do not retry, delegate, ask for tool approval, or claim the failed run completed successfully.

metadata.iteration_budget_note: 8 allows reading the terminal or clarification handoff and delivering a response or question. Conservative engineering defaults, not successful-completion guarantees.
metadata.replay: No on_recovery or rerun_on_recovery. Persisted matching state suppresses normal restart repeats.
metadata.run_assertion: Idempotent assertion of the existing origin-rooted run; does not reset lifecycle phase.
